content: Nameŋ-nâŋec soŋaŋkenšepeneŋ
Âgofâc-nane, ŋoŋe bocjahazi qaqazu gie baniŋte mi fotarienšepieŋ. Manaŋgopieŋ, mumutara dameŋko Wofuŋzi qaqazu nâŋe wiac bašihuc enâreocmu.
Nâŋâc mâmâc sasawa wiac gâbâ esifuckeeŋgopeneŋ. Ŋic moc e dâŋko moc mi sâqoreocmu, e ŋic saric sarahaŋne mucnezo. Iŋucnezi me sahac-ticne sasawa guriŋne sâcne bafâreocmu.
Becâsic jaŋe dâŋnâŋec reŋkeniŋte micko kiki râe-jareeŋgopeneŋ. Erâ izi becsâko bac bâtikic ejareeŋgopeneŋ.
Wokere wâc manaeŋgopeneŋ, jaŋe kâcɋene sâko, erâ mâŋâŋ sanaŋnezi ficne suec-jopame raeŋgopieŋ, eme sifu guriŋ bapa e guriŋ piticne i bac bâtikic ehuc hata muocmu ijaha wokezi raocmu.
Eme ŋicnameŋ e iŋuc jaha wiac piticne, erâ wiac wemo afecne efeekac. Manaŋgopieŋ, šoc masisi i wiac huŋgaŋne mac, eme iŋucne maczi sopâc sâko rikepene šafâreekac.
Nameŋzi sisipiric eeŋgopeneŋ

Eme nameŋ-nâŋec šoc masisi iŋucnea wâc. Eki hâcne me sahac gâcne siric-jopahuc sâqocnere neŋgocne eekaczi sahac-nâŋec bâbie-fâreekac â juju-nâŋecte ŋesiŋ rikeme šafâreekac” e jahacne ine hârâckonec šoczi qâhâsâme šaekac.
Qowi fuŋne fuŋne tiŋkonec â hâweckonec erâ wipe homa wiac i ŋiczi bâmâteŋkezo murâ bâmâteŋkeeŋgopeneŋ.
Nameŋ ine mo ŋic mozi bâmâteŋkeocmu? E gapec tâmiric ririsiehuc sâqocne baekac, qotâre micopâzi fusucmakicne tinac.
Nameŋ-nâŋeczi Wofuŋ Mamac muteŋkeeŋgopeneŋ, erâ nameŋzia ŋic Anuture hawarifâc sâwec-jopaeŋgopeneŋ.
Mic ijaha mumuteŋ â sâwec wahaekac. Âgofâc-nane, iŋuc wemocte?
Opâ šâŋe ijaha nocne â hâtâne ataŋ wahaekac me?
Âgofâc, hâmeŋko woraŋ fuaocmu? Me saŋko hâmeŋ fuaocmu? Me hâweczi nocne eocmu?
Mamana hata faicnec â juwicnec
Ŋoŋerao maŋɋârâŋhec â maŋ manahuc wiac ee iŋucne moc juŋgopieŋ me? Ine wama ruaine juhuc eebapa biaŋne bâfuahuc maŋɋârâŋ-jeŋicte fuŋne bataniŋkenšepieŋ.
Á maŋjeŋicko iiŋguuŋ hâtâne â hehefaric fohame ine sahac-jeŋic bafehuc dâŋfâri manaŋgopeneŋ mupie burec eocmu.
Maŋɋârâŋ hata iŋucne i faicnec wahakicne mi muzo, aricne, mâŋɋârâŋ hata iŋucne i mâreŋkonec, ŋickonec, Sataŋtaonec.
Iiŋguuŋ â hehefaric foocmu ijaha wâc fâfâuc â wiac gâgâpâcne gâcne gâcne fofâreocmu.
Maŋɋârâŋ hata faicnec izi ine wiac šiŋuc bâfuaekac: Qanaŋ maŋɋaɋac, erâ wama, miriŋ, micrereŋ, uruc jauŋhec juju â mitire fârine gâcne, erâ wâc maŋguru tâmiric â siocmâc juju.
Wamare guriŋne baeŋgopieŋ jaŋe wamao ukicne sara mamac epie fârine tiŋne juju fua-jareekac.
